entity_reviews.llm_reasoning: The extracted value for "Target Formula" is blank, but the paper explicitly states/proposes specific formulas for the Li-Al-Co-O-F solid solution/doping layer. In the Results text and Fig. 1b, the authors "tentatively propose Li1/3Al1/3Co2/3O4/3F2/3" as the most probable structure (also shown in Fig. 1b). Later in the Discussion they also mention a likely delithiated structure "Li1/9Al1/3Co2/3O4/3F2/3". Therefore, leaving the Target Formula empty is not supported by the document.
entity_reviews.llm_suggested_fix: Li1/3Al1/3Co2/3O4/3F2/3 (proposed most probable Li-Al-Co-O-F solid-solution structure; Fig. 1b / Results). If the target is the delithiated surface solid solution at 4.6 V, then Li1/9Al1/3Co2/3O4/3F2/3 (Discussion).
